about: Monica W. Latin is an attorney at Carrington, Coleman, Sloman & Blumenthal, L.L.P. and helps clients address Business Litigation legal issues. She also assists clients regarding Appellate and Employment & Labor: Employer issues.
Super Lawyers is a designation of top-rated practicing attorneys selected through extensive evaluation. She was awarded this distinction for 2003 - 2026.

Monica Latin was admitted to practice law in 1993. She represents clients in the Dallas area.
